education.description:
Data technology is essential for shaping the future. Computing challenges are becoming more complex and must be solved through collaboration between users, businesses, and society. This programme builds competence to tackle exciting problems for the future.
 Data technology is central to artificial intelligence, medical technology, and the Internet of Things (IoT), as well as other forward-looking technologies. It plays a key role in addressing society's major challenges in climate, sustainability, and health. This two-year master's programme builds on a bachelor's degree in computer engineering and leads to the civil engineer (sivilingeniør) degree. The main profile is artificial intelligence.

Do you want to develop future secure and sustainable IT solutions? It's difficult to imagine everyday life without the use of apps and digital solutions. How these systems are made and developed affects sustainability elements such as power consumption, lifespan and efficiency. Society is already significantly digitized, and the process continues at an ever-increasing pace. 
 The Data Engineering program gives you practical competence in programming, where you learn to build sustainable IT systems and services. IT systems must be developed continuously in collaboration with customers and users. High demands are placed on user-friendliness, security, privacy and climate footprint. As a data engineer, you are well suited to solve these problems.
